open_points.subject: A18 backup contents
open_points.text: “a later backup holds whatever the store holds when its own snapshot is taken” contradicts “A backup holds every record but the agent sessions (M06), which are removed from the copy before it is encrypted.”
open_points.question: Does the later backup contain agent-session records present at its snapshot, or are those records always removed?
options: It contains every snapshotted record, including agent sessions.
Agent sessions are always removed; “whatever the store holds” means every otherwise backup-eligible record.
open_points.default_guess: Treat A18 rule 2 as the explicit exception and remove agent sessions from every backup.

witness.initial: A registered agent session with a granted and active project exists in the store before a backup snapshot begins.
events: The backup run takes its store snapshot while that session exists.
The owner later restores that backup after losing the store.
Cabinet Kernel inspects or re-registers the session identity.
outcomes: Under “whatever the store holds,” the restored store contains the snapshotted session and its grant.
Under A18 rule 2, the restored store contains no agent session, and Kernel must register it again before the owner grants projects again.
witness.observer: The owner and Cabinet Kernel after restore
